# Security Policy

This is an educational project and not intended for production use.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Please open an Issue with the label `type:bug` and include:
- A clear description and steps to reproduce
- A minimal test case if possible

If you believe the issue should be reported privately first, contact a maintainer directly.

## Scope & SLA
We aim to acknowledge reports within a week, but timelines are not guaranteed. Security updates may be addressed as normal bug fixes.
